text: Every import starts the same way: export a file from the old system… then fix the columns by hand. Example does both for you.
This is the public demo… a fictional sample file. No real customer data, and nothing is saved. You would upload your own export here. For the demo, we will use the sample.

screen: Review step — parsed fields and the raw-vs-clean comparison
text: Example reads the file and pulls out every field. Here the export wrote the capital I in ITEM as a lowercase L… Example caught it before it reached your records.

screen: Settings — a native select and a confirm() dialog
text: Pick the destination from the list… and confirm. Headless Chromium never paints native menus or dialogs, so the recorder draws the menu itself and answers the dialog for you.

screen: Integrations page (captured in the user's own Chrome; see shots.example.json)
text: If your team already runs on another system, connect it once from Integrations… and that is the whole setup.
This is a product demonstration with sample data. Try it yourself at example.com/demo. No signup needed.
